productLaunches.description: Clipboard history that can read your screenshots - Clipboard history and screenshots, searchable together. Stays on your Mac. $9.

productLaunches.title: Doneit 3.2
productLaunches.description: Reimagined Doneit Assist, support for Siri AI, and more - You can now attach photos when planning tasks with Doneit Assist to turn a handwritten list, whiteboard or a document into tasks, include additional details to make tasks more accurate, as well as let it suggest reminders and attributes for tasks, and break tasks into subtasks. Doneit Assist can now also create a brief summary of a task list, highlight its key tasks for you to focus on, as well as show the upcoming tasks in this list.

productLaunches.title: VoiceCap
productLaunches.description: The AI notetaker for meetings in your language - Most AI notetakers are strong in English and mediocre in everything else. VoiceCap transcribes in 100+ languages and writes the summary, action items and decisions in that same language. Record in the room via native apps, send a bot to Zoom, Meet or Teams, or upload a file. Every meeting becomes a searchable record of what was decided and who owns it. Ask Claude or ChatGPT about it over MCP. EU company, recordings stored in Frankfurt, never used to train models. 300 free minutes, no card.

productLaunches.title: Ruby UTCP
productLaunches.description: The scalable, secure alternative to MCP for tool calling - Ruby UTCP brings UTCP 1.1 to Ruby, giving apps and AI agents a standard way to discover and call tools over native protocols. It supports 12 transports, including HTTP, CLI, WebSocket, gRPC, GraphQL, MCP and WebRTC, plus streaming, auth, OpenAPI discovery, and CodeMode for programmable multi-tool workflows. Open source and built for the Ruby ecosystem.

items.description: The scalable, secure alternative to MCP for tool calling - Ruby UTCP brings UTCP 1.1 to Ruby, giving apps and AI agents a standard way to discover and call tools over native protocols. It supports 12 transports, including HTTP, CLI, WebSocket, gRPC, GraphQL, MCP and WebRTC, plus streaming, auth, OpenAPI discovery, and CodeMode for programmable multi-tool workflows. Open source and built for the Ruby ecosystem.
